contract.guarantee: For every Python string passed to the pinned _safe_path_segment helper, the returned value is nonempty, contains no forward slash or backslash, is not the path component . or .., and uses only ASCII letters, digits, underscore, dot, or hyphen. Each call therefore contributes exactly one relative filesystem path component when the value is joined under the artifact directory. This guarantee excludes symlink ancestry, host_root provenance, and path-name collisions.
